english:
... [hymn] with its canons. Song, "He shall come down like rain." Litany, "Holy Mother."
"Holy God," according to the proper of the day.
Psalm 67 [68]: "The Lord shall give the word." Book of Song of Songs 6:3: "Beautiful you are," to verse 8: "they praised her." Prophet Malachi 3:1:
"Thus says the Lord," to verse 2: "of His manifestation." Epistle to the Galatians 3:24: "So the law was our tutor," to verse 29: "heirs."
Alleluia: "Rejoice, O favored one." Gospel
Luke 1:39: "Mary arose," to verse
56: "to her house." "Creator of all" [Ararchakan hymn] according to the proper of the day. Litany, "Holy Mother of God," "Save [us, O Lord]." Prayer, "Receive, O Lord."
Midday Liturgy Introit, "We beseech you." Antiphon,
"My soul magnifies." Hymn Tone 3 [gd]: "Tree of Life."
And then read the scriptures of the day. Eucharistic Hymn [Serabasutyun], "Multitudes." In the Evening: Mesedi,
"My soul magnifies." Litany, "Holy Mother."
Hambartsi [Hymn at the Evening Procession] Tone 3 [gd]: "New Zion." Afterward: "Holy Mother of God," "Save [us, O Lord]." Prayer: "Receive, O Lord."

And then the Fast of Saint James [Hakob] of Nisibis [Mtsbin], the Patriarch, but feast days are celebrated.
Monday. Of the Holy Saints: Minas, Hermogenes [Yermogine], Evgraphus [Yevgrap'os], and the voluntary
poor: John [Hovhannes] and Alexius [Aleksianos]. Canon of Patristic Martyrs. Magnificat [Mankunk] and Hambartsi
Tone 2 [bk]: "The memory of the witnesses." Midday Liturgy Psalm
115 [116]: "Precious is." Proverbs 15:33:
"The fear of the Lord," to verse 16:7: "in the day of evil." Prophet Isaiah 18:7: "In that time," to verse 7: "to Mount Zion."
Epistle to the Philippians 1:27: "Brethren, only,"
to chapter 2:4: "of others." Alleluia of the Martyrs
in the tone of the day. Gospel Matthew 10:37:
"He who loves father," to verse 42: "his reward."
Tuesday. Of the Holy Saints: Cornelius the Centurion, Shmawon [Simeon] the kinsman of Christ, Polycarp the Patriarch
of Smyrna, and the Martyrs who were consummated in the East. [Hymn] of the Martyrs. Canon:
say that of the Seventy [Disciples]. Midday Liturgy Psalm 18 [19]:
"Through all the earth." Book of Wisdom 1:1:
"Love righteousness," to verse 7: "fills the world." Prophet Jeremiah 16:16:
"Behold, I," to verse 21: "my name is the Lord."
Acts 1:12: "Then they returned,"
to verse 14: "and his brothers." Alleluia: "You shall appoint." Gospel Mark 6:6: "And He went about,"
[and] healed them.
Wednesday. Canon of Repentance.
Midday Liturgy Psalm 85 [86]: "Save your servant."
Epistle 2 Thessalonians 2:1: "We beseech you,"
to verse 16: "of goodness." Alleluia in the tone of the day.
Gospel Luke 14:25: "And there went with Him," to verse 27: "to be a disciple."

Thursday. Of the Holy Saints: Eustratius [Yevtstratios],
Auxentius [Oksentios], Eugene [Yevgines], Orestes [Ovrestees], and
Mardarius. Canon of the Martyrs. Magnificat [Mankunk]
and Hambartsi Tone 2 [bk]: "He who by the fire of Your love." Midday Liturgy
Psalm 5: "They shall glory." Proverbs 1:1: "To know wisdom," to verse 9: "upon your neck." Prophet Nahum 2:1:
"Be strengthened," to verse 7: "were made manifest." Epistle
Romans 5:1: "Therefore, having been justified,"
to verse 5: "was given to us." Gospel Matthew
5:1: "And seeing," to verse 12: "they were before you."
Friday. Canon of Rest. Midday Liturgy
Psalm 97 [98]: "All have seen." Epistle
2 Thessalonians 3:1: "Finally, brethren,"
to verse 18: "with you, Amen." Alleluia in the tone of the day. Gospel
Luke 15:1: "And there drew near," to verse 7: "repentance."

Saturday. Of the Holy Saints: James [Hakob] of Nisibis [Mtsbin] the Patriarch, Maruge the Hermit, and
Melitus the Bishop. [Hymn] Tone 3 [gk]: "Victorious and holy," with its canons. Midday Liturgy
Introit, "The Patriarchal." Hymn,
"Who from the wilderness." Psalm 131 [132]: "Your priests." Proverbs [Wisdom] 7:12: "I rejoiced,"
to verse 20: "the virtues of roots." Prophet
Isaiah 44:1: "But now hear," to verse
5: "shall write." Epistle Hebrews
13:17: "Obey them," to verse 21: "forever, Amen." Alleluia: "Your priests." Gospel
John 9:39: "And Jesus said,"
to chapter 10:10: "they may have." In the Evening: "Joyful Light" [Luys Zvart], and the rest in order.
